metric_definitions.margin_valid_positions: Number of valid sampled training positions included in margin summaries; zero means margin measurements are unavailable and reported as null.
metric_definitions.recent_residual_probe_status: measured: version-2 recent residual measured; no_valid_positions: no usable positions; baseline: no residual; unsupported_residual_architecture: residual scale probe does not apply to this architecture. Margin probes still run.
metric_definitions.measurement_availability: Null means unavailable, not zero. Embedding cosine requires at least two catalog items; sampled-logit spread requires a usable diagnostic batch.
metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Range ~[0,1]. Estimated by mean pairwise cosine similarity of sampled item embeddings (mapped to [0,1]). Higher means stronger mean directional alignment; 0.5 corresponds to mean cosine zero. This does not measure recommendation diversity, semantic compatibility or simulator traits.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean of (pos_logit - neg_logit) over valid positions; higher means clearer separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Counts low-margin and wrong-rank valid positions. Category lists remain empty because item categories are unavailable. Margins use sampled training negatives and do not estimate full-catalog ranking performance.
metric_definitions.sampled_logit_std: Population standard deviation of positive and negative logits on the first usable diagnostic batch; describes score scale, not validation accuracy.
metric_definitions.recent_alpha: Current unconstrained learned scalar; initialized to exactly zero.
metric_definitions.recent_alpha_last_retained_gradient: Signed alpha gradient retained from the most recent backward pass, or null when unavailable; this probe does not perform backward or optimizer steps.
metric_definitions.recent_pool_feature_norm_ratio: Mean per-position raw recent-pool L2 norm divided by encoder-feature L2 norm, on valid positions of the first usable diagnostic batch.
metric_definitions.recent_effective_residual_norm: Mean L2 norm of alpha times the raw recent pool on the same positions.
metric_definitions.recent_effective_residual_feature_ratio: Mean per-position effective-residual L2 norm divided by encoder-feature L2 norm on the same positions.
metric_definitions.recent_probe_positions: Number of valid positions used for residual diagnostics.
